content.title: Did Lamar Odom die? Here’s why the story is taking the internet by storm
content.text: Confusion surrounding Lamar Odom’s health and status has gone viral online after the release of a new Netflix documentary, leading several users to ask: “Did Lamar Odom die?” Despite the speculation, the former NBA star is alive, and the renewed attention is mainly driven by the documentary’s dramatic framing of his past near-death experience.Netflix documentary sparks confusionLamar Odom is at the spotlight following Netflix’s recent sports documentary, Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom, which revisits his basketball career, addiction struggles, and recovery path.As stated in coverage of the release, “Lamar Odom is the subject of a new Netflix documentary: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom, telling the story behind the former 14-year NBA star and his struggles with addiction.”The title itself has created misunderstanding among viewers, with many wrongly assuming it refers to his death rather than his survival story.Why the internet is asking if Lamar Odom diedThe question mainly emerged due to the resurfaced information of Odom’s 2015 medical emergency, when he suffered a drug overdose that almost killed him.When combined with the emotional presentation of the documentary, it has triggered the rapid spread of misinformation across social media platforms. In reality, Odom survived the incident and is still alive today, although his recovery process has been lengthy and complicated.The 2015 overdose and medical crisisIn October 2015, Odom was discovered unconscious at a Nevada brothel after allegedly using drugs. He suffered kidney failure, multiple strokes, and heart attacks, and was in a coma. Physicians later confirmed that oxygen deprivation resulted in severe damage to his brain and organs, making his survival highly uncertain.Addiction, recovery, and ongoing struggleThe documentary features how Odom’s journey did not end after surviving the coma. Instead, it portrays years of healing, relapse, and attempts to rebuild his life while dealing with addiction as an ongoing medical condition rather than a one-time event. It also focuses on the broader medical understanding that addiction is a chronic illness, not a lack of discipline, and often involves frequent cycles of recovery and relapse.Odom speaks on trauma and healingIn a USA TODAY interview referenced in reporting on the documentary, Odom stated:"I was telling my girlfriend on the way here, it's like swimming in a cesspool of trauma. And I'm trying to get out of it, but the story reels me back into that pool every time. But I just know I'm bigger than the situation, and I hope to help a lot of people by giving my testimony. Not just with the story, but just in life, that we can all overcome addiction."At the time, he was reportedly almost 60 days sober, as per the interview context.“Walking miracle” survivalOdom has earlier explained his survival as medically extraordinary:"When I woke up, the doctors told me I’d probably never walk and talk again. So, us having this conversation is a win. All of my doctors say I’m like a walking miracle because it’s, like, medically impossible for somebody to survive 12 strokes and six heart attacks while in a coma. And so I just take it day by day, and I’m more than grateful for life."Legal issues and past struggles resurfaceThe renewed focus has also resulted in focus on Odom’s past legal troubles. In January 2026, he was arrested in Las Vegas on DUI-related charges, that includes speeding and lane violations, as per the reports from TMZ.FAQs:Q1. Is Lamar Odom dead? No, Lamar Odom is alive. The confusion comes from the title of a Netflix documentary about his past health crisis.Q2. Why are people searching for Lamar Odom’s death? People misinterpreted the documentary title and his 2015 overdose story. This led to viral speculation online.
